ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dominant low-intensity (black/dark-grey) central pixels and high-intensity (white/light-grey) distal patches, approximately 70:30 ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigment across the peduncle and central lobes. Large, contiguous white/light-grey high-contrast patches localized to the trailing margins of the distal lobes, with significant pixel mottling at the interior boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with high depth-to-width ratio, sharply dividing the primary lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, medium-frequency serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude and jaggedness on the lateral margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to textured, semi-rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly distinct clusters of high-contrast, beige/white circular barnacle formations located at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the dark pigmented surface of the right lobe; one distinct circular white scar is visible on the lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula spp.) at the fluke tips; small circular depigmented scar on the left lobe near the leading edge transition.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black 'island' of pigment isolated within the white patch of the right distal tip.
